target_questions.question: Can the two hydrogen injections independently control homogeneity and stratification in H2DDI?
target_questions.target_basis: Tier 1 A026 links injection timing to combustion mode; this paper separates first- and second-injection roles.

evidence_candidates.claim_text: In the tested split-injection strategy, early first hydrogen injection promoted a homogeneous premixed mixture, while later or higher-energy second injection increased stratification and mixing-controlled behavior.
evidence_candidates.evidence_summary: The experiment independently varies the timing and energy fraction of the two hydrogen injections at fixed total energy and combustion phasing.

limitations: Small-bore single-cylinder engine and fixed intermediate load; the roles are strategy-specific.
visual_verification: Targeted visual verification performed where numeric/glyph-dependent abstract claims required it; no figure digitization.
